name: Dream Aquarium Mini
style: A LITERAL TINY REAL AQUARIUM THAT IS AN MP3 PLAYER. Thick optically clear aquarium glass with visible edges and a visible waterline, extremely transparent realistic clear water (not opaque blue gel), believable refraction through water, suspended tiny bubbles, a little sand and miniature aquatic plants at bottom, tiny fish and translucent jellyfish behind the electronics. Water and tank have actual physical depth. The dark glass screen is a slim waterproof module suspended in front of the transparent water, NOT an aquarium picture printed on a flat player. Back of the glass tank is visible through water. Chrome/aqua transport controls on a waterproof strip along lower front. Beautiful studio aquarium product photography realism, tiny caustic highlights.
